intent: Unit IS the surface 'turn completed history consumer': AZ-06 service-credential-proof enforced by the pinned ServiceCredentialVerifier before anything is appended; SessionAccessCheck confirms the session tenant. Permitted events map to a user message and an assistant reply entry, each with its token count, offered to HistoryEventBuffer. Unauthenticated or tenant-mismatched events are dropped and audited through AuditPort as session access denied.

methods.signature: Mono<Void> consume(String serviceId, String secret, String sessionId, String turnId, String userId, String tenantId, int userSequence, String userMessage, int userTokens, int replySequence, String assistantReply, int replyTokens)
methods.semantics: event dropped, never thrown, when credential or tenant check fails
